## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass in `backend/` (and, for the app, the unit tests of the Android repository)
- [ ] A prompt change comes with the evaluation result before and after
- [ ] The privacy rules are untouched, or the change explains why and how they stay safe
- [ ] Guides and [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, personal text or instance addresses in any file or message
- [ ] I understand and tested this change. An AI assistant helped: yes / no
